currentObjective: Cycles, limits and concurrency hardening complete
decisions: Cycle, depth, method-budget, cancellation, and cache-in-progress boundaries collapse to Unknown for public complexity output in Phase 5; recursion complexity is not solved.
Root methods count as depth 0. MaximumCallDepth = 5 allows five uncached callee expansions from a root and stops the sixth at an Unknown boundary.
MaximumMethodsPerRootAnalysis counts uncached method expansion reservations per root analysis state, not per Compilation, so one root cannot permanently consume another root's budget.

The per-compilation template cache treats missing entries as NotStarted, explicit InProgress entries as non-blocking Analyzing markers, and stores only Completed Known templates from production analysis in this step.
Unknown caused exclusively by depth limit, method budget, cancellation, active call path cycle, or contextual InProgress cache races is not stored as a permanent cache entry.
When another root finds a callee InProgress, it analyzes the callee independently under its own root state instead of waiting, avoiding A-waits-for-B/B-waits-for-A cache deadlocks.
constraints: Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not create ProjectReference, binary reference, local package dependency, or transitive dependency on inherited projects.
Do not add Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces, MathNet, or SymPy.

Do not implement recursion solving, recurrence extraction, Master Theorem, Akra-Bazzi, whole-solution call graph, external decompilation, full virtual hierarchy analysis, or CodeFixProvider in Phase 5.
Keep Unknown conservative for unresolved calls, unsafe dispatch, unavailable source, unproven argument binding, exceeded budget, and detected cycles.
Keep analyzer hot paths deterministic, cancellation-aware, concurrency-safe, and free from I/O, network access, process execution, and reflection-heavy behavior.
